title: No personal email addresses or home-folder paths in tracked files
assertion: Every tracked text file is free of personal email addresses and home-folder paths. Allowed: GitHub noreply addresses, reserved example domains, git@ in SSH remotes, emails declared in pyproject.toml's [project] authors and maintainers, emails in SECURITY.md, placeholder home folders (/Users/me, /home/user, C:\Users\you, runner, Shared), and any line marked 'swerepo: allow-privacy'.

origin.text: Day-one rule agreed with the owner for Phase 0 (ADR-20261119-6b94, SWEREPO-SPEC section 6.4 and 6.8 rule 1): personal details must never leak into the repository.
